problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute a fixed budget across 16 infrastructure projects to maximize the total expected benefit to the community.
The profile for each project is as follows:
* Project A: expected benefit is 0.047, community disruption is 0.034, allocation bounds [0.087, 0.592]
* Project B: expected benefit is 0.043, community disruption is 0.156, allocation bounds [0.019, 0.671]
* Project C: expected benefit is 0.183, community disruption is 0.043, allocation bounds [0.019, 0.884]
* Project D: expected benefit is 0.171, community disruption is 0.202, allocation bounds [0.075, 0.516]
* Project E: expected benefit is 0.114, community disruption is 0.062, allocation bounds [0.060, 0.704]
* Project F: expected benefit is 0.073, community disruption is 0.063, allocation bounds [0.087, 0.714]
* Project G: expected benefit is 0.029, community disruption is 0.124, allocation bounds [0.011, 0.537]
* Project H: expected benefit is 0.034, community disruption is 0.034, allocation bounds [0.053, 0.482]
* Project I: expected benefit is 0.028, community disruption is 0.264, allocation bounds [0.001, 0.375]
* Project J: expected benefit is 0.039, community disruption is 0.096, allocation bounds [0.012, 0.308]
* Project K: expected benefit is 0.096, community disruption is 0.180, allocation bounds [0.017, 0.367]
* Project L: expected benefit is 0.037, community disruption is 0.142, allocation bounds [0.048, 0.310]
* Project M: expected benefit is 0.139, community disruption is 0.204, allocation bounds [0.069, 0.882]
* Project N: expected benefit is 0.122, community disruption is 0.191, allocation bounds [0.087, 0.815]
* Project O: expected benefit is 0.066, community disruption is 0.087, allocation bounds [0.097, 0.426]
* Project P: expected benefit is 0.066, community disruption is 0.290, allocation bounds [0.060, 0.689]
Each project must receive a budget share that falls within its specified allocation bounds, and the sum of all budget shares must equal the total available budget. To ensure equitable geographic distribution, the planner requires that the group of projects located in priority zones, represented by the subset PZ = {G, J, N, P}, collectively receive at least 0.220 of the total budget. Furthermore, the total community disruption index for the entire portfolio must not exceed 0.170, and the total expected benefit must be at least 0.053. Please determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total expected benefit while satisfying all constraints.
